scenes.say: Is one eyelid slowly drooping? Here are three signs you should never ignore, in elders and in kids.

scenes.en: A small muscle lifts your eyelid. With age it can stretch and weaken.
scenes.say: A small muscle lifts your upper eyelid. With age, this muscle can stretch and weaken. Some children are born with a weak lifting muscle.

scenes.en: Tilting the head back or raising eyebrows to see
scenes.say: Sign one. Tilting the head back, or raising the eyebrows, just to see clearly. Watch for this in children too.

scenes.en: The lid covers part of the pupil, so the upper view looks cut off
scenes.ta: இமை கண்மணியை மூடுவதால் மேல் பார்வை மறைகிறது
scenes.say: Sign two. The eyelid covers part of the pupil, so the top of your view seems blocked.

scenes.en: Often more noticeable by evening or in photos
scenes.ta: ஒரு கண் மற்றதை விட சிறியதாகத் தெரிகிறது
scenes.say: Sign three. One eye looks smaller than the other, especially in photos, or by evening.

scenes.en: In kids, a droopy lid can block vision and lead to a lazy eye if not checked early.
scenes.say: Did you know? In young children, a droopy eyelid can block vision and lead to a lazy eye, if it is not checked early.

scenes.en: It droops suddenly, with double vision, severe headache or a weak face
scenes.ta: திடீரென்று இமை தொங்கினால் உடனே மருத்துவரிடம் செல்லுங்கள்
scenes.say: Get urgent medical care the same day if an eyelid droops suddenly, especially with double vision, a severe headache, or weakness in the face.

scenes.en: Most droopy eyelids can be treated. Book an eye test.
scenes.say: Most droopy eyelids can be treated. Don't ignore it. Book an eye test today.
